---
name: Pull Request
about: Template for submitting bug fixes and changes
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

## Description
Brief description of what this PR does.

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## Changes Made
- [ ] List the specific changes made
- [ ] Be as detailed as necessary
- [ ] Include file names if helpful

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Hot fix (urgent production fix)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Describe how you tested this change
- [ ] List any test cases you ran
- [ ] Confirm existing functionality still works

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots to show the changes, especially for UI modifications.

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have tested this in the appropriate environment
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## Additional Notes
Any additional information that reviewers should know.
